_comment: Plugin-owned Claude Code settings, rendered into the private state
directory each turn and passed to `claude --settings`. It carries one
two things: the gate on the Bash tool, and the gate on the browser.
This is not the user's permission policy — that is claude-settings.json,
which the user edits through the panel's grant cards. Nothing here is
user-editable, because a gate anything could switch off is not a gate.
The 180s allows bin/confirm.sh its full 120s question plus room to open
the panel; the hook must outlive the card, or the card would sit there
answering a question nothing is still waiting for.
